notes: The reference edit's first real test: it put the pose photo's own woman into the result almost untouched instead of the character's identity, and the face pass afterward — 0.45 denoise on a small crop — wasn't strong enough to pull it back. The instruction to the edit model now spells out that image 2's woman must not appear at all, not just that image 1's should; its sampler's CFG goes from 2.5 to 4 so it actually follows that instead of defaulting to whichever input looks most like a photograph; and the face pass denoise goes from 0.45 to 0.6 so the identity LoRA has room to overwrite a wrong face rather than just polish it.
